decision: Retain original election observations but distinguish individual candidates, endorsed ballot campaigns, and non-person ballot options in policy coverage.
scope: Exact labels in United States presidential contests only. This is not a general name-matching rule. Local offices containing the word President are not national presidential races.

evidence.fields: Official Democratic ballot-option display name and vote count. Not every original source row is in the current strict study registry.
Official Democratic ballot-option display name and vote count.

interpretation: The30 generic opponent ballot-option records are not30 people with missing personal platforms. The7 endorsed2024 ballot campaigns still require attributable campaign evidence; no policy is inferred merely from the ballot label. No votes, source rows, primary records or reviewed quotations are deleted by this accounting change.
national_worklist: Same-cycle presidential records may share a research work unit using the existing explicit alias map. Such grouping does not merge election records, establish source applicability before a particular primary, or create independent observations.
